description: Synthetic MinerU middle.json (layout.json), 3 A4 pages, single-column Chinese physical-chemistry textbook chapter (quantum chemistry). Geometry is generated and self-consistent (CJK 12pt text, 16pt line pitch; lines inside blocks, spans inside lines, nothing zero-area, all inside the page). Block labels follow the MinerU vlm middle.json shape: title(level), text, list(+text children), interline_equation, code(code_caption+code_body), image(image_body x2 + image_caption), chart(chart_body+chart_caption), page_footnote, discarded header/footer/page_number/aside_text. Discarded blocks carry no index (sorted after para_blocks).

features.feature: section titles level 2 and 3 on other pages
one line split into three spans (text / inline_equation / text), Chinese without spaces
features.expect: segments text, inline_formula, text; observe whether a space is inserted between CJK span and formula in block text

features.feature: inline formula mid-sentence (\hat{H}) at start of a line
features.expect: body paragraph with one inline_formula segment; lines joined across the line break

features.feature: inline formulas inside a sentence referencing 式(2.3)
features.expect: two inline_formula segments (E, \psi) between Chinese text spans
formula/display_formula, translate=false, number stays inside the latex text

features.feature: bulleted list (list container, 3 text children, bullet glyph in text)
features.expect: ONE aggregated list_item block (children not emitted separately), bbox = union of descendant lines

features.feature: numbered list (list container, 3 text children, '1.' prefix in text)
code block group: code_caption + code_body with 4 lines, indented lines
features.expect: code_body -> kind code, text_flow preserve_lines, '\n' between 4 lines; caption linked via caption_target_block_id

features.feature: image group with two image_body children and one image_caption

chart_body becomes kind image/figure; chart_caption layout caption linked to it
structure_role metadata, translate=false; second header at discarded_blocks/1

features.feature: page_footnote with an inline formula span at page bottom

tricky_points: Segment texts are joined with ASCII space even between CJK spans and between CJK lines, so a Chinese sentence broken across lines/spans gets spaces inside words (e.g. '定态薛定谔方 程'). Snapshot pins this behaviour.
Code lines: preserve_lines strips each span, so leading indentation of code lines is lost ('    num = ...' becomes 'num = ...').
A list/index container is flattened to one block; item boundaries survive only as a space between joined line texts and in lines[].
Interline equation number lives inside latex as \tag{2.3}; no separate formula_number block.
Image group with two image_body children: only the first image is the caption target; second image has no caption link.
chart_body is projected as kind image/figure (no chart kind); chart_caption has sub_type chart_caption.
angle is only copied to metadata.raw_angle; a rotated para_block text is still translate=true body.
aside_text with angle 90 gets layout_role paragraph (while semantic/structure metadata) -- cosmetic mismatch with NORMALIZATION.md which says unknown.
Discarded blocks carry no index here: raw_index is null and they are ordered after all para_blocks regardless of position on the page.
All three title levels get block_class title / structure_role heading; the level only survives in metadata.raw_title_level.
